items.detail: Figure 5 (energy and latency of the four reference implementations on NUCLEO-L4R5ZI) is not recoverable from the extracted text; no numeric latency (inferences per second) or energy (micro-Joules per inference) values exist in any project file. Figure FIG-5 is blocked (NO_VALID_VISUAL) and no substitute is drawn.
Table 2 check-mark/X columns (dataset, training, model, numerics, framework, hardware modification marks) are not legible in the extraction; only row contents are used.
Table 1 cell alignment is inferred from list order; text of section 4 confirms all quality targets except the model sizes 52.5 KB (KWS) and 270 KB (AD), which appear only in Table 1.

Section 3 says 'As Table 1 summarizes, there is a clear and distinct need'; the Table 1 in the extraction is the list of v0.5 benchmarks, so the comparison table the sentence refers to is absent. No comparison table is reproduced.
No variance, confidence interval or number of repeated training runs is reported for any accuracy or AUC value (E009, E011, E014, E017). Single values only.
No measured accuracy, latency or energy values from the v0.5 submissions appear in the extracted text or README; only the descriptive Table 2 rows and the qualitative insights of section 6.2.

References [1] (TinyML foundation), [2] (Brainchip), [16] (Moreau, TinyMLPerf speech commands) and [19] (Torelli and Bangale, MLMark white paper) give no year in the project reference list, so they cannot be cited in the (FirstAuthor, Year) form and are not registered; they are mentioned by name only.
